description: Find third-party library source cards. This is the only library lookup: text, exact filters, and newest-first browsing. Output is { count, sources }. Each source has id, title, publisher, authors, date_published (YYYY-MM-DD or null), url, type, category, status, summary, tags, verified_at, and featured only when it is true. count is the rows returned, not the catalog size. query words must all match as case-insensitive substrings of id, title, summary, publisher, type, authors, or tags. category, tag, type, status, featured, and updated_since are AND filters. Omit query to list the newest sources, optionally in one category. Results are newest date_published first, undated last. limit is 1-50 (default 10) with no offset. No matches returns count 0 and sources []. A non-calendar updated_since, or an unknown category, returns an isError result. A status outside the enum is invalid input. A failed library read returns isError whose text is the Error message. Use get_source instead when you already have a source id. Use list_categories instead when you need category ids, labels, and counts rather than source cards. Use list_changes instead when you need the unpaged cross-catalog changelog rather than source cards. Use get_protocol_facts instead when you need cited facts for a payment protocol. Use list_articles instead for this site's own articles. Free, no auth.

category.description: Category id from list_categories, e.g. bitcoin-lightning. Combined with the other filters (AND). Omit for every category.

featured.description: true returns only featured sources. Omit or false to include all.

limit.description: Maximum rows, 1-50, default 10. Values above 50 are rejected. There is no offset; narrow the filters to see other matches.

query.description: Space-separated words; every word must match (AND), case-insensitive substring of id, title, summary, publisher, type, authors, or tags. Example: lightning l402. Omit or use an empty string to skip the text filter.

status.description: Exact library status: proposal, individual_draft, working_group_draft, standard, spec_released, product_docs, news, research, or unknown. Combined with the other filters (AND).

tag.description: One tag, exact match, e.g. l402. Combined with the other filters (AND).

type.description: Source type from the enum, e.g. spec. Combined with the other filters (AND).

updated_since.description: YYYY-MM-DD calendar date. Keeps sources whose verified_at is later than this date (exclusive). A value that is not that form returns an isError result. Example: 2026-10-01.

name: search_sources
title: Search library sources
